caption:
L'Oréal just signed its first ever football club, and it picked PSG.

Vichy becomes the official skincare and haircare partner of the men's first team through 2028, with scientists running skin and scalp studies at PSG Campus.

Also today: LendUX x Adelaide United (A-League Women, front-of-jersey).
